items.stem: A vendor shows a demo with 99% accuracy. What should you do before relying on that figure?

options.text: Ask how, on what data and for which task the figure was measured
options.rationale: Correct: accuracy claims are meaningless without the task, data and method behind them.

options.text: Accept it because the demo looked convincing
options.rationale: A demo is not evidence of real-world performance.

options.text: Assume it applies to your data unchanged
options.rationale: Performance usually drops on different, real data.

options.text: Ignore accuracy and focus only on price

items.explanation: Correct: accuracy claims are meaningless without the task, data and method behind them.

items.stem: Which TWO checks most protect you when evaluating an AI vendor's data handling? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Confirm where data is stored, processed and who can access it
options.rationale: Correct: knowing data location and access is central to risk.

options.text: Review the contract terms on data reuse and deletion
options.rationale: Correct: reuse and deletion terms define real data control.

options.text: Rely on the vendor's marketing promise of security
options.rationale: Marketing claims are not enforceable protections.

options.text: Assume compliance because the vendor is well known
options.rationale: Brand size does not guarantee compliant data handling.

items.explanation: Correct: knowing data location and access is central to risk.
